correctness.rationale: For every pair of four orbit representatives, the independently reconstructed exact 2401-by-2499 Jacobian at a fixed integer parameter point has rank 2401 over GF(8), with a named nonzero 2401-square pivot minor and stored determinant/pivot hash; direct finite differences verify the differentiation. A cyclotomic ring homomorphism maps zeta_7 to an order-seven GF8 element, so nonzero minors lift to nonzero minors over C and imply dominance. Scaling gives dimension <=16*145=2320<2401 at r=16; triality and scaling cover all 49 pairs; constructibility gives exact generic width. This is a finite nonvanishing certificate with a characteristic-zero proof, not finite experimentation substituted for proof.

originality.rationale: The initiating 2026 paper states generic-width equality as Conjecture 11.1 and has no q=7 filling certificate. The closest publicly available exact q=7 report has 16th secant rank2320 and expressly leaves r=17 open; its full RESULT was inspected. General phylogenetic-mixture theorems require more leaves than the relevant tripod. Actual searches found no stronger covering theorem, subject to unindexed-literature risk.
residual_risks: Semantic searches and inspected papers are not an exhaustive priority proof; specialized unindexed phylogenetic or tensor literature may contain an equivalent filling result.

value.rationale: Solves the first missing filling step q=7 of a published natural generic-width conjecture for all twisted and untwisted central-character sectors. The penultimate secant was already known to have codimension 81; a full-dimensional seventeenth secant is new information resolving exact generic algebraic decomposability for every type and cannot be inferred from earlier lower-order ranks.
